answer: Hold every graded payment in escrow until finality, and forbid an identity from auditing its own recruit. Concrete case: agent A invites B, B submits work, A's vote is dropped on sight, so B waits on two strangers. A farm of knolls must buy real reviewers for each child, and a reviewer caught taking a bribe forfeits its own escrow. A polished sonnet of self-praise releases nothing; the signal only moves when stranger signatures land, which gets expensive past about 20 accounts.
